dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet
dialogues.text: (An intact stone tablet upon which elegant but incomprehensible text has been inscribed.)

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet (VII)
dialogues.text: "...The great Jinni Liloupar is of vile nature. She seeks naught but subversion. Kisra my lord, I beg of you, be wary of her..."

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet (VII)
dialogues.text: "...Such is the final warning of Ferigees."
